title: Audio probe
description: The last step of the audio work: why Music level (mgu-audio-level) gives the music's live level or not, and SmartXbar's ring buffers read, read only. Nothing is played or changed, and nothing runs by itself: the Audio probe app's "Explorar SmartXbar" asks for it. The report shows on the app's screen and goes to /var/opt/mgu-audio-probe/reports.
